en.title: Sustainability Assessment
en.summary: AHP model to rank sustainability criteria across materials and processes.
en.challenge: Sustainability choices combine environmental, economic, and social criteria with different units and stakeholder priorities, so a transparent ranking method was required.
contribution: Structured the decision hierarchy and pairwise-comparison inputs for Analytic Hierarchy Process weighting.
Implemented AHP consistency checks and alternative rankings with weighted-sum and TOPSIS methods.
Built Python/Excel data flows and visualizations to make assumptions and sensitivity visible.
technical: Excel inputs capture criteria, alternatives, and stakeholder judgments.
Python/NumPy calculates normalized matrices, priority vectors, and consistency ratios.
WSM and TOPSIS compare alternatives and provide cross-method validation.

architecture.label: Decision model
architecture.detail: Goal, criteria, subcriteria, alternatives, and pairwise judgments define the hierarchy.

architecture.label: Weighting
architecture.detail: AHP derives criteria priorities and checks judgment consistency.

architecture.label: Ranking
architecture.detail: WSM and TOPSIS score alternatives under the selected weights.

architecture.label: Review
architecture.detail: Tables and plots expose ranking, sensitivity, and disagreements between methods.

outcomes: Produced an auditable sustainability decision model instead of an opaque single score.
Demonstrated operations research, data preparation, numerical implementation, and stakeholder framing.
Published the implementation as a reusable public repository.

zh.title: 永續性評估
zh.summary: 以 AHP 評估材料與製程的永續性優先順序。
zh.challenge: 永續決策同時包含單位不同的環境、經濟與社會準則，以及各異的利害關係人優先順序，因此需要透明的排序方法。
contribution: 建立決策階層與成對比較輸入，用於層級分析法的權重計算。
實作 AHP 一致性檢查，並以加權總和法與 TOPSIS 進行替代方案排序。
建立 Python 與 Excel 資料流程及視覺化，使假設與敏感度清楚可見。
technical: Excel 輸入記錄準則、替代方案與利害關係人判斷。
Python 與 NumPy 計算正規化矩陣、優先向量及一致性比率。
WSM 與 TOPSIS 比較替代方案，並提供跨方法驗證。

architecture.label: 決策模型
architecture.detail: 目標、準則、次準則、替代方案與成對判斷共同定義階層。

architecture.label: 權重計算
architecture.detail: AHP 推導準則優先順序，並檢查判斷的一致性。

architecture.label: 排序
architecture.detail: WSM 與 TOPSIS 依選定權重計算替代方案分數。

architecture.label: 檢視
architecture.detail: 表格與圖表呈現排序、敏感度及不同方法之間的差異。

outcomes: 建立可稽核的永續決策模型，而非不透明的單一分數。
展現作業研究、資料準備、數值實作與利害關係人問題框架能力。
將實作發布為可重用的公開儲存庫。
